name: Venture Co. Letters
summary: At Windshear Mine, Venture Co. Letters carry word of the cartel’s work in Stonetalon Mountains. Recovered during a covert operation, they give the night elf Sentinels intelligence on goblin operations.

sections.title: Industrial Intelligence
sections.body: Venture Company machines cut timber and strip-mine the ancient woodland around Windshear Crag. Alliance operatives set off covert sabotage to distract the workers and enter Windshear Mine. There, they recover letters with private messages and logistical records of the company’s local work. Sentinel leaders can use them to learn how the defilers arrange their workforce and supply lines.

sections.title: Delivery to the Sentinels
sections.body: The letters reach Sentinel commander Kaela Shadowspear from deep inside Windshear Mine. Goblin defilers and Horde incursions pressure the Sentinels across Stonetalon. The stolen correspondence helps them anticipate the Venture Company’s next moves and protect what remains of the sacred mountains.

faq.q: What are the Venture Co. Letters?
faq.answer: The Venture Co. Letters are internal correspondence and operational records kept by the Venture Company at Windshear Mine in Stonetalon Mountains.
The letters are among Venture Co. Documents inside Windshear Mine, at the eastern end of Windshear Crag.
Gnome operative Gaxim Rustfizzle oversees the effort to steal the letters. They are delivered to Kaela Shadowspear, leader of the local night elf Sentinels.

faq.q: Why do the Sentinels need this correspondence?
faq.answer: The Sentinels fight to halt deforestation and excavation in Stonetalon. The letters reveal Venture Company plans and priorities, helping the defenders plan against them.

angles.text: Goblin lumber machines desecrate Stonetalon’s wilderness. Intelligence on Venture Company schemes matters greatly to the Sentinels.
Alliance scouts carry out covert operations against the Venture Company to protect night elf holdings in Stonetalon from industrial exploitation.
